app.name: Wasl
nav.label: Sections
conn.not_found: Wasl couldn't find its background service (wasld). Reinstall Wasl, or start wasld yourself.
pairs.title: Folder pairs
pairs.empty_body: A folder pair keeps a folder on this computer and a folder on Google Drive the same.
pairs.remove_body: Wasl stops syncing this pair. Files on this computer and on Drive are not touched.
pairs.removed: Removed {name}. Files on this computer and on Drive were not touched.
pairs.shared: {name} now syncs with your devices too.
pairs.unshared: {name} no longer syncs with your devices.
pairs.share_use_code: Use a code from another device
pairs.share_use_title: Sync {name} with a folder on another device
pairs.share_use_body: On the other device, turn on “Sync with my devices” for its folder and copy the share code it shows. Files in both folders are merged.
pairs.share_code_invalid: That isn't a share code. Copy it again from the other device: it's 32 letters and digits.
pairs.share_joined: {name} syncs with the same folder on your other devices.
views.title: Views
views.intro: A view shows a Google Drive folder on this computer. Files appear at full size and download only when you open them. Nothing you change in a view is uploaded.
views.empty_body: Add a view to browse a Drive folder here without downloading all of it.
views.unsupported_title: Views aren't available on this computer yet
views.unsupported_body: Files on demand work on Windows and Linux for now. Folder pairs work as usual.
views.space: On this computer: {used}, of which {pinned} is kept here
views.limit_label: Space for files you haven't kept
views.local_changes_one: {count} thing in this folder isn't from Drive. It stays here and is never uploaded.
views.local_changes_other: {count} things in this folder aren't from Drive. They stay here and are never uploaded.
views.change_changed_here: changed here; Drive keeps its version
views.change_differs: a different file than the one on Drive
views.change_unsupported: Windows can't show it on demand
views.change_failed: couldn't be updated; Wasl tries again on the next refresh
views.change_restored: changed here, so Drive's version was put back; the changed copy is kept in Wasl's data folder
views.freed: Space freed in {name}. Files download again when opened.
views.remove_body: Files you kept on this computer stay as ordinary files; the others are removed from this computer. Nothing on Google Drive changes.
views.remove_keep_all: Download every file first and keep them all
views.error_vault: This folder is an encrypted vault, locked on this computer. Unlock it to show its files. While it is locked, Wasl keeps none of its content here except the files you chose to keep.
addview.title: Add view
addview.path_preview: The view will be the new folder {path}
addview.space_help: Files you open stay here until this space is needed. Files you keep here don't count.
addview.missing_place: Choose where the view goes on this computer.
addview.added: {name} is ready. Open its folder to browse.
addview.added_not_yet: {name} was added but can't show its files yet: {message}
devices.title: Devices
devices.off_body: Device sync is off on this computer, so it syncs with Google Drive only. Other computers and phones can't pair with it.
devices.path_punched: over the internet, through both routers
devices.only_this: No other device yet. Add one below.
devices.listening: Other devices reach this computer on port {port}.
devices.remove_body: It will never sync with your devices again. Pairing it again later gives it a new identity. Device ID: {id}
devices.connect_help: When a device of yours isn't found on its own, type its address as host:port.
devices.connect_invalid: Type the address as host:port, for example 192.168.1.20:47100.
pairing.invite_title: Show a code on this computer
pairing.invite_body: Then scan it or paste it on the new device. Both devices show four words to check.
pairing.join_help: Paste the code the other device shows. It starts with WASL:
pairing.join_empty: Paste the code the other device shows.
pairing.show_code: On the new device, scan this code in Wasl, or paste the text code under “Join a device”.
pairing.code_ready: The pairing code is ready. Waiting for the other device.
pairing.qr_label: QR code of the pairing code
pairing.qr_too_long: The code is too long for a QR code. Copy the text instead.
pairing.code_once: The code works once. Waiting for the other device…
pairing.words_lead: Both devices now show four words:
pairing.words_ask: Are these the same on the other device?
pairing.waiting_other: Waiting for the other device to confirm…
pairing.paired_next: To sync a folder with it, turn on “Sync with my devices” for a folder pair.
pairing.fail_expired: The pairing code expired. Make a new one.
pairing.fail_timeout: The other device took too long to answer.
pairing.fail_code: The code didn't match. Make a new one and try again.
pairing.fail_cancelled: Pairing was cancelled on one of the devices.
pairing.fail_other: Pairing failed. Make a new code and try again.
pairing.fail_words: You said the words don't match. Nothing was added.
pairing.fail_busy: A pairing is already open. Finish or cancel it first.
pairing.fail_not_code: That isn't a pairing code. Copy the whole code the other device shows: it starts with WASL:
pairing.fail_own_code: That code was made on this computer. Paste it on the other device instead.
progress.label: Sync progress for {name}
progress.phase.deleting: Moving deleted files to the bin
method.two_way_desc: Changes and deletions on either side are copied to the other.
method.upload_only_desc: New and changed files on this computer go to Drive. Nothing is deleted on Drive.
method.download_only_desc: New and changed Drive files come to this computer. Nothing is deleted here.
method.upload_mirror_desc: The Drive folder becomes an exact copy of the folder on this computer.
method.download_mirror_desc: The folder on this computer becomes an exact copy of the Drive folder.
method.upload_then_delete_desc: Move files from this computer to Drive.
method.download_then_delete_desc: Move files from Drive to this computer.
method.mirror_warning: A mirror deletes files on the other side that aren't in this one. Check the preview before you start.
add.title: Add folder pair
add.waiting_google: Waiting for Google… Finish signing in in your browser.
add.signin_link: If your browser didn't open, open this address:
add.create_missing: Create the folder if it doesn't exist
add.path_not_found: There's no folder at that path on Drive. Check the spelling, or browse for it.
add.rules_hint: .waslignore files in the folder always apply. These add to them.
add.rules_gitignore: What .gitignore files leave out of git
add.rules_hidden: Sync hidden files and folders (names starting with a dot)
add.missing_folder: Choose a folder on this computer.
preview.title: Preview: {name}
preview.loading: Comparing folders… Large folders take a while the first time.
preview.intro: Nothing has changed yet. This is what the sync will do.
preview.delete_local: Delete on this computer (to Wasl's recycle bin)
preview.blocked: A safety check stopped this plan: {reason}
preview.sample_deletes: Some of the files it deletes
preview.nothing: Both sides are already the same.
problems.title: Problems
problems.empty_body: Conflicts, stopped syncs and accounts that need to sign in show up here.
problems.approved: Approved. Syncing {name} once with this plan.
history.title: History
history.empty_body: Each sync is listed here with what it changed.
history.open: Details of the sync of {name} at {when}
run.empty: Nothing was recorded for this sync.
bin.title: Recycle bin
bin.empty_body: Files a sync deletes stay here for a while, so you can restore them.
bin.empty_count_one: The {count} file in it is deleted forever. This can't be undone.
bin.empty_count_other: All {count} files in it are deleted forever. This can't be undone.
bin.total_one: {count} file · {size} · deleted files stay here 30 days
bin.total_other: {count} files · {size} · deleted files stay here 30 days
history.no_match_body: Try another pair, outcome or time, or clear the filters.
settings.title: Settings
settings.startup_body: Start Wasl's background service when you sign in to this computer.
settings.remove_account_body: Wasl forgets this account. Files on this computer and on Drive stay where they are.
update.out_toast: Wasl {version} is out. Settings › About has the download link.
settings.accent_body: Selection and focus take your system's accent colour instead of Wasl navy.
settings.accent_missing: Wasl couldn't read your Windows accent colour, so it stays Wasl navy for now.
settings.service_needed: Start Wasl's background service to see your accounts.
settings.sync_guard_body: A sync that would delete many files waits for your OK. Nothing is deleted until you say so.
settings.sync_bin: Deleted files go to the recycle bin
settings.sync_bin_body: You can restore them from Recycle bin.
settings.sync_pairs_body: Each pair's direction and skip rules are in Edit pair.
settings.notify_title: Notify me when something needs me
settings.notify_body: Wasl tells you about decisions and failures, never about routine syncs.
common.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
errors.disconnected: Lost the connection to the background service. Reconnecting…
errors.auth: Google needs you to sign in again.
errors.network: Can't reach Google Drive. Check the internet connection.
errors.busy: Wasl is busy with another sync. Try again in a moment.
errors.cli_missing: The wasl command isn't installed next to the app.
errors.screen: This screen couldn't be shown. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart Wasl.
errors.kind.Auth: Google needs you to sign in again.
errors.kind.Permission: Wasl isn't allowed to open this folder.
errors.kind.NotFound: The folder is gone. Choose it again.
errors.kind.Locked: The vault is locked on this computer. Unlock it to sync.
errors.kind.Network: Can't reach Google Drive. It will try again.
errors.kind.RateLimit: Google Drive asked Wasl to slow down. It will try again shortly.
errors.kind.Server: Google Drive had a problem. It will try again.
errors.kind.Io: A file couldn't be read or written on this computer.
errors.kind.Integrity: A file didn't arrive intact, so it wasn't used. It will try again.
vault.encrypt_help: Files are encrypted on this computer before they reach Google Drive; their names and contents can't be read without the passphrase. The Drive folder must be new or empty.
vault.passphrase_help: At least {min} characters. A sentence of several words is easy to remember and strong.
vault.too_short: The passphrase needs at least {min} characters.
vault.lose_warning: If you lose the passphrase, this vault's files are lost: no one can recover them, not Google and not Wasl. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe.
vault.making_keys: Making the vault's keys. This takes a few seconds on purpose.
vault.checking: Checking the passphrase. This takes a few seconds on purpose.
vault.unlock_body: Type the vault's passphrase. Its keys stay on this computer, in the system keychain, until you lock it; the passphrase itself is never kept.
errors.plain_on_vault: This Drive folder is an encrypted vault, but the pair isn't linked to it, so nothing was synced. Remove the pair and add it again to sync through the vault.
errors.plain_on_damaged_vault: This Drive folder has a damaged vault.json, so it may be an encrypted vault. Nothing was synced. Check the folder on Drive.
agents.title: Agent changes
agents.intro: When an AI agent such as Claude Code or Gemini changes files in a synced folder, Wasl keeps those changes on this computer until you decide. Accept sends them everywhere; Revert puts every file back.
agents.empty_title: No agent has changed anything yet
agents.empty_body: Run an agent with “wasl agent run --as <name> -- <command>”, or add Claude Code's hooks with “wasl agent hooks claude-code”.
agents.none_waiting_body: Every agent change has been accepted or reverted.
agents.still_working: Still working. The changes appear here when the session ends.
agents.confirm_in_dialog: Confirm in the Wasl window that just opened (code {code}). {agent}'s changes wait until you do.
agents.not_confirmed: {agent}'s changes were not accepted: the confirmation was declined or timed out. They still wait for you.
agents.try_again_one: {agent}'s last confirmation was declined or timed out. You can ask again in {count} minute.
agents.try_again_other: {agent}'s last confirmation was declined or timed out. You can ask again in {count} minutes.
agents.accept_note: Accepting always asks you again in a separate Wasl window, so an agent can't accept its own work.
agents.revert_body_one: {count} item goes back to how it was before the session. The agent's version goes to the recycle bin, so you can undo this.
agents.revert_body_other: {count} items go back to how they were before the session. The agent's versions go to the recycle bin, so you can undo this.
agents.reverted_some_one: Put back {count} item. {skipped} changed after the session and stayed as it is.
agents.reverted_some_other: Put back {count} items. {skipped} changed after the session and stayed as they are.
agents.ended: Ended {agent}'s session. Its changes wait for you here.
agents.setup_claude_body: Add these hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json (or a project's .claude/settings.json). Every request then becomes one changeset here, and each file Claude edits is kept first.
agents.setup_other_body: Start the agent through Wasl, in the synced folder it should work in. Replace gemini with the agent's command.
problems.agent_changes_body: Their files stay on this computer and don't sync until you accept or revert them.
problems.needs_you_one: {count} needs you · nothing is lost while it waits
problems.needs_you_other: {count} need you · nothing is lost while these wait
problems.item_sub_preview: New pair · nothing syncs until you start it
deletions.body: A safety check stopped this sync before it deleted them. Nothing has been deleted yet.
deletions.sample_note: Showing {shown} of {count}. The full list couldn't be read: {message}
deletions.footnote: Restore puts the files back where they went missing. Files Wasl deletes stay in the recycle bin for 30 days.
deletions.stopped_body: A safety check stopped this sync. Nothing has changed yet. Approve it to run once with this plan.
conflict.body: Both sides changed since the last sync. Both copies are safe.
conflict.footnote: Keep both leaves this device's edit as a separate copy beside Drive's.
intro.added_by: Added by {name}. It gets nothing shared with all your devices until you keep it.
intro.added_elsewhere: Added by another of your devices. It gets nothing shared with all your devices until you keep it.
intro.pick_title: Where should {folder} go on this computer?
intro.accepted: {folder} is ready. Look at the preview, then start it.
intro.with_all_and: Shared with all your devices, and offered to {names}
intro.choose_for: Choose the devices {name} is shared with
intro.choose_body: Each device you tick is offered this folder and syncs it once accepted there. Untick one to stop sharing with it.
intro.all_devices_hint: Every device kept on this computer, now and later.
intro.offer_none: No folder here syncs with devices yet. Turn on “Sync with my devices” for one, then offer it.
intro.offer_body: {name} sees each folder you tick and chooses whether to accept it. Nothing is offered unless you tick it.
intro.paired_next: It gets no folder from this computer until you offer one. Your other devices show it as new until you keep it there.
banner.approval_one: A pair is waiting for your OK
banner.approval_other: {count} pairs are waiting for your OK
banner.approval_body: Wasl stopped before a large change. Nothing was deleted.
banner.preview_one: A new pair is waiting for its first preview
banner.preview_other: {count} new pairs are waiting for their first preview
banner.preview_body: Nothing syncs until you see what the first sync will do and start it.
banner.failed_body: Your files are safe. Problems says what to do.
banner.auth: Google Drive needs you to sign in again
banner.auth_body: Syncing with Drive stopped. Syncing straight between your devices goes on.
banner.conflict_one: A file changed in two places
banner.conflict_body: Both copies are kept until you choose.
inspector.empty: Select a pair to see it here.
inspector.skipped_hint: Files the last sync passed over. Files your skip rules leave out aren't counted here.
pairs.empty_hint: Choose a folder to sync. You’ll see what syncs before anything moves.
pairs.remove_many_body: Wasl stops syncing these pairs. Files on this computer and on Drive are not touched.
pairs.removed_many_one: Removed {count} pair. Files on this computer and on Drive were not touched.
pairs.removed_many_other: Removed {count} pairs. Files on this computer and on Drive were not touched.
detail.hold_body: Nothing syncs until you look at what this pair will do and start it.
shell.footer_free_label: Least space on a pair's disk
pairsheet.new_body: You'll see what syncs before anything moves.
pairsheet.edit_body: Change the name or the direction of {name}.
pairsheet.confirm_delete_upload_mirror: From its next sync, without a preview, files in the Drive folder that aren't in the folder on this computer are deleted from Drive.
pairsheet.confirm_delete_download_mirror: From its next sync, without a preview, files on this computer that aren't in the Drive folder are deleted from this computer.
pairsheet.confirm_delete_upload_then_del: From its next sync, without a preview, each file is deleted from this computer once it has reached Drive.
pairsheet.confirm_delete_download_then_d: From its next sync, without a preview, each file is deleted from Drive once it has reached this computer.
pairsheet.folders_fixed: To sync another folder, add a new pair. Removing this one leaves the files on both sides as they are.
pairsheet.refuse_overlap: The pair {pair} already syncs this folder, or one in or around it. Two pairs on the same files can undo each other. Choose another folder.
pairsheet.refuse_view: This folder is in or around the view {view}, which is read-only. Choose another folder.
pairsheet.refuse_own: Wasl keeps its own data in or around this folder. Choose another folder.
pairsheet.refuse_vault_empty: Type a passphrase for the vault.
pairsheet.refuse_vault_not_empty: This Drive folder isn't empty. A new vault needs a new or empty Drive folder.
pairsheet.refuse_vault_exists: This Drive folder already holds a vault. Unlock it instead.
pairsheet.refuse_vault_other: This Drive folder belongs to a different vault or passphrase.
pairsheet.drop_vault_body: {name} is an encrypted vault. The new Drive folder {path} won't be encrypted: files will be uploaded there as they are, readable by anyone with access to it.
pairsheet.vault_kept: The new vault in {path} was kept on Drive. Saving again uses it.
pairsheet.folders_move: Another folder starts this pair over: Wasl shows a preview of its first sync and changes nothing until you approve it.
pairsheet.folders_move_shared: A pair shared with your devices waits until you share it again.
pairsheet.edit_body_folders: Change the name, the folders or the direction of {name}.
pairsheet.saved_moved: Saved {name}. It waits for you to approve its preview.
pairsheet.refuse_syncing: {name} is syncing. Stop it or let it finish, then change its folders.
alert.starting_body: Your folder pairs show again in a moment.
alert.stopped_body: Nothing syncs until it runs again. Your files are safe.
alert.offline_body: Changes wait on this computer and sync when you’re back online. There’s nothing to do.
alert.auth_one: Google Drive stopped syncing for a pair
alert.auth_other: Google Drive stopped syncing for {count} pairs
alert.auth_body: Your Google sign-in expired. Syncing straight between your devices goes on.
alert.quota_body_pair: {name} stopped until there’s space in your Google Drive. Free up space there, then sync again.
alert.quota_body_one: A pair stopped until there’s space in your Google Drive. Free up space there, then sync again.
alert.quota_body_other: {count} pairs stopped until there’s space in your Google Drive. Free up space there, then sync again.
alert.missing_pair: The Drive folder for {name} is gone
alert.missing_one: A pair lost its Drive folder
alert.missing_body: It was deleted, moved to the bin, or is no longer shared. Nothing on this computer was deleted.
alert.pane_stopped: Your folder pairs show here when the service runs.
first.note: If you choose a vault, files are encrypted on this computer before anything is uploaded.
first.sign_in_body: Wasl opens your browser so you can sign in with Google. It syncs only the folders you choose.
first.folder_body: You’ll see exactly what will sync before anything moves.
first.folder_none_mac: Choose a folder on this Mac.
first.folder_none_win: Choose a folder on this PC.
devices.empty_body: Add a phone or another computer below to sync with it directly, without Google Drive.
drop.overlay: Drop a folder to create a pair
drop.not_folder: Only folders can be paired. Drop a folder, not a file.
drop.not_ready: Wasl isn't connected yet. Drop the folder again once it is.
drop.busy: Close the open sheet first, then drop the folder again.
drop.kept: Folder kept. It will be ready at the folder step.
pairs.drop_hint_mac: You can also drop a folder on Wasl in the Dock.
pairs.drop_hint_win: You can also drop a folder anywhere on this window.
notify.conflict_body: A file changed in both places. Choose which copy to keep.
notify.failed_body: Nothing was deleted. Open Wasl to see why.
notify.auth_title: Sign in to Google Drive again
notify.auth_body: Drive pairs for {name} wait until you do. Nothing was deleted.
notify.deletion_body: Wasl stopped before deleting many files. Review them first.
notify.offer_body: Nothing syncs until you accept it.
notify.pairing_body: Check that both screens show the same four words.
settings.tray_mac: Show Wasl in the menu bar
settings.tray_win: Show Wasl in the notification area
settings.tray_body_mac: When it's hidden, Wasl stays in the Dock.
settings.tray_body_win: When it's hidden, open Wasl from the Start menu.
settings.notify_conflict_body: A file changed on both sides.
settings.notify_failed_body: A pair failed, or Google Drive needs you to sign in again.
settings.notify_deletion_body: Wasl stopped before deleting many files.
settings.notify_pairing_body: A device asks to pair, or offers you a folder.
first.step_tray_mac: Keep Wasl in the menu bar
first.step_tray_win: Keep Wasl in the notification area
first.tray_body_mac: Wasl keeps syncing when you close its window. Its icon in the menu bar shows how things stand and opens Wasl.
first.tray_body_win: Wasl keeps syncing when you close its window. Its icon in the notification area shows how things stand and opens Wasl.
guard.delete_drive_one: This sync would delete {count} file on Drive, {percent}% of the folder.
guard.delete_drive_other: This sync would delete {count} files on Drive, {percent}% of the folder.
guard.delete_drive_keep: Drive still has every file until you decide.
guard.delete_device_one: This sync would delete {count} file on this device, {percent}% of the folder.
guard.delete_device_other: This sync would delete {count} files on this device, {percent}% of the folder.
guard.delete_device_keep: This device still has every file until you decide.
guard.wipe_drive: The folder on this device is empty but was synced before. Wasl won't empty Drive to match it.
guard.wipe_device: The Drive folder is empty but was synced before. Wasl won't empty this device's folder to match it.
guard.merge: The first sync merges two folders that both have files: {here} on this device and {drive} on Drive.
guard.merge_bin_here_one: {count} file only on this device goes to its recycle bin, so it matches Drive.
guard.merge_bin_here_other: {count} files only on this device go to its recycle bin, so it matches Drive.
guard.merge_bin_drive_one: {count} file only on Drive goes to Drive's bin, so it matches this device.
guard.merge_bin_drive_other: {count} files only on Drive go to Drive's bin, so it matches this device.
